hypotheses.hypothesis: EPS Surprise >= 10% alone predicts robust subsequent excess returns.
hypotheses.evidence: Large blind earnings-event testing did not show a clear robust excess-return edge.
hypotheses.resurrectionRule: Requires a new economic mechanism or an independent dataset; threshold retuning alone is insufficient.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large EPS beat plus weak immediate post-announcement price response is a robust standalone alpha signal.
hypotheses.evidence: Validation did not establish a robust standalone edge.
hypotheses.resurrectionRule: Requires a new economic mechanism or an independent dataset; threshold retuning alone is insufficient.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large beat plus immediate price rise is a robust standalone alpha signal.
hypotheses.evidence: Blind testing did not establish a clear robust edge.
hypotheses.resurrectionRule: Requires a new economic mechanism or an independent dataset; threshold retuning alone is insufficient.

hypotheses.hypothesis: EPS beat plus weak pre-earnings 3-month price momentum contains a persistent standalone alpha.
hypotheses.evidence: The validation sample showed an interesting directional result, but bootstrap confidence intervals still included zero.
hypotheses.resurrectionRule: May be retested only as a preregistered hypothesis on independent point-in-time or prospective data.
